direction: Decompose depot closure and test the cost of over-weighting the return leg.
hypothesis: Discounting or reversing the radial term may reduce the near-depot bias of pure closure cost.

operations.mechanism: Compare softened depot influence to a savings-style score. Preserve feasible-customer progress, make the depot start deliberate, and let current distance remain the dominant term.

preserve: Keep the existing CVRP interface, read-only inputs, feasibility and deterministic evaluation. Preserve useful incumbent structure unless the mechanism calls for a deliberate pivot.
reasoning_summary: Five candidates were valid, and the best closure-cost and fill variant scored 12.29975, worse than 12.11504. It improved instances 0, 4 and 5 but regressed on the other three. Use the collected round evidence directly.
